kind.description: Unique identifier for the type of current object. For this API, it is customsearch#search.

items.description: The current set of custom search results.

type.description: The MIME type of the OpenSearch URL template for the Custom Search JSON API.

spelling.description: Spell correction information for a query.

htmlCorrectedQuery.description: The corrected query, formatted in HTML.

nextPage.description: Metadata representing the next page of results, if applicable.

language.description: The language of the search results.

startIndex.description: The index of the current set of search results into the total set of results, where the index of the first result is 1.

hq.description: Appends the specified query terms to the query, as if they were combined with a logical `AND` operator.

totalResults.description: Estimated number of total search results. May not be accurate.

count.description: Number of search results returned in this set.

cx.description: The identifier of an engine created using the Programmable Search Engine [Control Panel](https://programmablesearchengine.google.com/). This is a custom property not defined in the OpenSearch spec. This parameter is **required**.

rights.description: Filters based on licensing. Supported values include: * `cc_publicdomain` * `cc_attribute` * `cc_sharealike` * `cc_noncommercial` * `cc_nonderived`

searchType.description: Allowed values are `web` or `image`. If unspecified, results are limited to webpages.

exactTerms.description: Identifies a phrase that all documents in the search results must contain.

filter.description: Activates or deactivates the automatic filtering of Google search results. See [Automatic Filtering](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#automaticFiltering) for more information about Google's search results filters. Valid values for this parameter are: * `0`: Disabled * `1`: Enabled (default) **Note**: By default, Google applies filtering to all search results to improve the quality of those results.

excludeTerms.description: Identifies a word or phrase that should not appear in any documents in the search results.

lowRange.description: Specifies the starting value for a search range. Use `cse:lowRange` and `cse:highrange` to append an inclusive search range of `lowRange...highRange` to the query.

orTerms.description: Provides additional search terms to check for in a document, where each document in the search results must contain at least one of the additional search terms. You can also use the [Boolean OR](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#BooleanOrSearch) query term for this type of query.

sort.description: Specifies that results should be sorted according to the specified expression. For example, sort by date.

siteSearch.description: Restricts results to URLs from a specified site.

dateRestrict.description: Restricts results to URLs based on date. Supported values include: * `d[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past days. * `w[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past weeks. * `m[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past months. * `y[number]`: requests results from the specified number of past years.

linkSite.description: Specifies that all results should contain a link to a specific URL.

safe.description: Specifies the [SafeSearch level](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#safeSearchLevels) used for filtering out adult results. name: customsearch

gl.description: Geolocation of end user. * The `gl` parameter value is a two-letter country code. The `gl` parameter boosts search results whose country of origin matches the parameter value. See the [Country Codes](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#countryCodes) page for a list of valid values. * Specifying a `gl` parameter value should lead to more relevant results. This is particularly true for international customers and, even more specifically, for customers in English- speaking countries other than the United States.

linkSite.description: Specifies that all search results should contain a link to a particular URL.

imgColorType.description: Returns black and white, grayscale, transparent, or color images. Acceptable values are: * `"color"` * `"gray"` * `"mono"`: black and white * `"trans"`: transparent background

orTerms.description: Provides additional search terms to check for in a document, where each document in the search results must contain at least one of the additional search terms.

num.description: Number of search results to return. * Valid values are integers between 1 and 10, inclusive.

c2coff.description: Enables or disables [Simplified and Traditional Chinese Search](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#chineseSearch). The default value for this parameter is 0 (zero), meaning that the feature is enabled. Supported values are: * `1`: Disabled * `0`: Enabled (default)

rights.description: Filters based on licensing. Supported values include: `cc_publicdomain`, `cc_attribute`, `cc_sharealike`, `cc_noncommercial`, `cc_nonderived` and combinations of these. See [typical combinations](https://wiki.creativecommons.org/wiki/CC_Search_integration).

filter.description: Controls turning on or off the duplicate content filter. * See [Automatic Filtering](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#automaticFiltering) for more information about Google's search results filters. Note that host crowding filtering applies only to multi-site searches. * By default, Google applies filtering to all search results to improve the quality of those results. Acceptable values are: * `0`: Turns off duplicate content filter. * `1`: Turns on duplicate content filter.

safe.description: Search safety level. Acceptable values are: * `"active"`: Enables SafeSearch filtering. * `"off"`: Disables SafeSearch filtering. (default)
enumDescriptions: SafeSearch mode unspecified. (Falls back to engine's configuration.)

lowRange.description: Specifies the starting value for a search range. Use `lowRange` and `highRange` to append an inclusive search range of `lowRange...highRange` to the query.

snippetLength.description: Optional. Maximum length of snippet text, in characters, to be returned with results. Note: this feature is limited to specific engines. * Valid values are integers between 161 and 1000, inclusive.

hl.description: Sets the user interface language. * Explicitly setting this parameter improves the performance and the quality of your search results. * See the [Interface Languages](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#wsInterfaceLanguages) section of [Internationalizing Queries and Results Presentation](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#wsInternationalizing) for more information, and [Supported Interface Languages](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/json_api_reference#interfaceLanguages) for a list of supported languages.

sort.description: The sort expression to apply to the results. The sort parameter specifies that the results be sorted according to the specified expression i.e. sort by date. [Example: sort=date](https://developers.google.com/custom-search/docs/structured_search#sort-by-attribute).

enumDescriptions: Exclude results from the listed sites.
